## Fixes

- Fix temporary directory setup failing on Windows systems with special characters in the user name
- Fix the address badge not showing the address selection menu for connections that are not fully configured yet
- Fix Proxmox containers offering a pause action that is not supported for containers
- Fix KeePassXC requests failing with a timeout if not handled fast enough
- Fix accepting a changed SSH host key not working for hosts on non-standard ports or with multiple names in the known_hosts entry
- Fix files owned by users or groups with very large IDs, e.g. from Active Directory, not being shown in the file browser
- Fix the UI freezing while a remote file opened with a double click in the file browser is being transferred
- Fix UI freezes when switching to or from file browser tabs with a docked terminal
- Fix connection entries showing an outdated state after the vault encryption was changed
- Fix poor window rendering performance on macOS
- Fix MCP run script tool failing to run scripts
- Fix settings failing to save on file systems that don't support atomic moves
- Fix various NullPointers

## Changes

- Workspaces can now be deleted from the workspace overview, including their data directory
- Unavailable workspaces can now be removed from the workspace overview without deleting their data directory
- Improve docker compose project listing performance on hosts with many containers
